description: Set in Otepoti/Dunedin - where coastlines, hills, and histories converge - this course introduces
creative writing as a practice of attention and connection. Through poetry, fiction, and
nonfiction, students explore language, place, and identity while engaging with Aotearoa New
Zealand's voices. Workshops, readings, and field visits to sites such as the Otago Peninsula and
Botanic Gardens support students in developing their creative voices within a collaborative
community of writers. Offered alternate years during January term.
fullname: Writing The World Around You: Creative Writing and Place in Aotearoa
